translations.web: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
translations.bsb: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
translations.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
translations.asv: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
